tanuki_subtitle: Native GitLab client for Apple platforms
tanuki_txt_1: This app does not collect any data for itself. All the data collected is managed by the GitLab instance you configured yourself.
tanuki_txt_2: To read more about the Terms and Privacy Policy you accepted when registering, go to the path "/-/users/terms" on your chosen GitLab instance.
tanuki_txt_3: When using "gitlab.com" for example, the link would be "https://gitlab.com/-/users/terms".
tanuki_txt_4: When the feedback form is used in the app or on the web, the IP address and user agent are stored in log files for 30 days.
tanuki_txt_5: The content of the feedback (optional email address and free text) is stored until the request has been processed or is no longer relevant.
